messages:
Priya S.: Vendor assessment confirmed 2026-10-12 09:00-12:00 UTC. Need a short custody plan: ephemeral RBAC, KMS delegate for uploads, readroom presigns, CloudTrail snapshot, and retest slots. Who picks each piece?

Ben I.: I can own ephemeral RBAC. Plan: role `pt_vendor_temp_<id>` with AssumeRole from vendor account, no console, max session 60m. Will add `revoke-role` script.

Maya R.: I'll own KMS & evidence flow. Prefer encrypt-only grants for uploads; never give Decrypt unless explicit approval. Sample grant (replace GRANTEE_ARN):

```
aws kms create-grant \\ 
  --key-id alias/pt-evidence \\ 
  --grantee-principal GRANTEE_ARN \\ 
  --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey \\ 
  --name "pt-upload-<eng-id>"
```

Maya R.: Presign PUT example for upload TTL 24h: `aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/uploads/<file> --expires-in 86400` and GET TTL 72h for readroom.

Priya S.: Observability: create dedicated CloudTrail filtered for S3/KMS/IAM, export snapshot at T+0 and T+end to forensics bucket with object-lock. Alert if KMS:Decrypt > baseline*2 in 10m.

Ben I.: IAM policy sketch: allow s3:PutObject to uploads/* via presign, allow s3:GetObject to readroom/*, deny s3:DeleteObject. Will put exact policy in tracker.

Priya S.: Proposed retest slots: 2026-10-15 14:00-15:30 UTC and 2026-10-16 09:00-10:30 UTC (90m each). Who can staff?

Ben I.: I can staff Oct 16. Will automate grant retire on session end.

Maya R.: I can staff Oct 15 and validate evidence manifests. Post-engagement: retire grants, revoke temp role, export+checksum trail, rotate key if Decrypt was granted, and attach manifest to ticket.

audit-bot: Preflight created "PT custody preflight" scheduled 2026-10-11 16:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to participants.

Priya S.: Action items: Ben = role + revoke script + policy; Maya = grant scripts + presign templates; Ben+Maya = schedule retest infra; Priya = CloudTrail snapshot job + alerts. Reconvene in preflight. Thanks.
